# Overview

## Problem statement

Widget events are delivered by a nightly batch, so dashboards lag by a day. See ACME-42 and WDG-CCH-001.

## Intended Audience

# Monitoring and Observability

## Logging

All services log JSON to stdout with a correlation id; payloads containing personal data are never logged.

## Alerting

# Security

## Threat Model

### Model

Mutual TLS between the relay and the widget service; secrets come from the vault, never from environment files. Related design: [Relay topology](https://example.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/EX/pages/1003/Relay+topology).
